creation_actions_committed.name: creation_actions_committed
creation_actions_committed.value: ("creation_actions"."status" = 'committed') = ("creation_actions"."erp_id" IS NOT NULL AND "creation_actions"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL)

creation_actions_approval.name: creation_actions_approval
creation_actions_approval.value: "creation_actions"."trigger" <> 'user_approval' OR ("creation_actions"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "creation_actions"."question_id" IS NOT NULL)

entitlement_overrides_one_kind.name: entitlement_overrides_one_kind
entitlement_overrides_one_kind.value: ("entitlement_overrides"."enabled" IS NOT NULL) <> ("entitlement_overrides"."limit_value" IS NOT NULL OR "entitlement_overrides"."unlimited")

extracted_fields_human.name: extracted_fields_human
extracted_fields_human.value: "extracted_fields"."source" NOT IN ('human_confirmed', 'human_corrected') OR "extracted_fields"."updated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL

imports_confirmed.name: imports_confirmed
imports_confirmed.value: ("imports"."status" = 'imported') = ("imports"."result_json" IS NOT NULL AND "imports"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "imports"."confirmed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

questions_answer.name: questions_answer
questions_answer.value: ("questions"."status" = 'answered') = ("questions"."answer_json" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."answered_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."answer_seq" IS NOT NULL)
